summary: Extensions turn the taxonomy into an observable lifecycle with risk-sensitive writes and measurable retrieval.

items.text: Use one event ledger with derived tier views, so a record can participate in several views without copying or losing provenance.
Define explicit promotion gates: repeated evidence may propose a semantic claim, while a procedural change additionally requires tests and authorized human approval.
Build a query planner that declares which tiers it searched, why each item was selected, and how conflicts or successor facts were resolved.
Evaluate tiers separately with working-context contamination tests, episodic temporal questions, semantic update cases, and procedural rollback scenarios.
